google-ads-conversion: Only the exact conversion and viewthroughconversion route families on the existing host suffixes are selected. gtag, first-party, CCM, privacy sandbox, server APIs and other endpoints need separate reviews.

New checks are advisory and require both cv=9 and async=1. They describe a pinned producer snapshot, not a complete receiver contract. Additional parameter hooks and URL processors can override producer output. Legacy and future producers are not assigned this profile.

Signed and exponent values are permitted within this profile. Legacy value checks remain. A conversion-action label is not required on remarketing. The pack makes no inference about configured conversion actions or accounting policies.
URL, referrer and top-frame fields are checked only for the producer 512 UTF-16-unit truncation bound. Custom schemes, incomplete URLs and arbitrary custom data escaping remain opaque.

Configured order IDs, user IDs, custom-data fields, currency/account eligibility, tag consent state, cookies, attribution, deduplication, delivery, redirects, and collector acceptance need external evidence. No timestamp age or global privacy flag requirement is invented.
kevel: Only the existing /i.gif, /e.gif and /r routes are selected. The separate /conv/{id} API remains explicitly uncovered. It has distinct empty-value and duplicate-parameter semantics that must not inherit event-shim requirements.

New event multiplier checks are advisory and use the two documented inclusive numeric ranges. The source does not explicitly require integers. Fractions within each interval are allowed; JSON decimal and exponent spelling is accepted without claiming receiver parser equivalence.
Event multiplier placement override and revenue effects are not recomputed from a single pixel. Override revenue is not assumed to scale with the multiplier.

Bare and empty noredirect flags remain accepted. Shim and signature authenticity, expiry, bot filtering, impression/click deduplication, trusted client forwarding, configured metadata and delivery require external context.

producer_controls.result: Original pinned Google script executed in Chromium. Synthetic page and all resulting requests intercepted. This proves emitted format, not remote acceptance.

review_notes: No raw vendor source or article snapshot is distributed. URLs and hashes identify local review evidence.

Numeric interval format reuses exact numeric-text comparisons. Empty lists and reversed/non-comparable endpoints are rejected at load. Existing format branches are unchanged and checked by the full native suite.
Reviewed shared artifact hashes are refreshed for additive format support; each unrelated vendor retains its own source review and remaining requirements.
New fields are added only where the source supplies a concrete constraint. Opaque custom data and IDs are not counted as new checks.
